version_history.change: stage-2 report: DFT-PBE comparison and criteria Cij, twin (ideal shear, proposed), glide_us, isf, Pt; tests E and S proposed in docs/POPIN_VALIDATION.md section 4.3, E not in the table

tests E and S accepted by the user as admission criteria: E added (M(001) and M(111) against the Djemia 2004 C_ij), the ideal-shear criterion renamed S (criteria.S, criteria_tolerances.S_rel; was twin, twin_rel), per-potential E and S results and an overall verdict (admitted, failed, not_evaluated; fracture_md.engines.dft_reference.admission_verdict)

criteria.Cij: C11, C12 and C44 each within 5 % of DFT (lit-sic recommendation)
criteria.E: test E: indentation modulus M(hkl) of the indented face (Vlassak-Nix, from the potential's relaxed-ion C_ij) within 10 % of M(hkl) from the measured single-crystal C_ij of 3C-SiC (Djemia 2004); faces (001) and (111), passes only when every face passes (passes_by_face per face); accepted by the user 2026-10-05
criteria.S: test S: (111)[11-2] easy-sense (twinning-sense) relaxed ideal shear strength within 15 % of this project's same-protocol DFT-PBE value, at 0 GPa (under the contact pressure once DFT has it); accepted by the user 2026-10-05
criteria.isf: 0 < ISF <= 50 mJ/m^2 (LS-R6 window; ISF = 0 leaves Shockley partials unbound)
criteria.Pt: B3 -> B1 static P_t within 10 GPa of DFT (LS-R5)

reference.kind: measured single-crystal elastic constants of 3C-SiC (Brillouin scattering, room temperature); a measurement, not a model value
reference.source: P. Djemia, Y. Roussigne, G. F. Dirras, K. M. Jackson, J. Appl. Phys. 95, 2324 (2004); data/reference_values/sic_3c.json; verified in outputs/indent_derisk/verify/lit-sic-chunk5.json (data/indentation/canonical_values.json experiment.sic3c_cij_GPa)

E.temperature_basis: the potential's 300 K relaxed-ion C_ij where the repository has them (Vashishta 2007), else its 0 K relaxed-ion C_ij of this table; verdicts.<potential>.E.basis
E.faces_rule: passes only when every face passes; passes_by_face gives each face for a study that indents one face
